$comment: Pinned model artefacts for the Kokoro image. `repo` and `revision` are the upstream coordinates; `files` maps every artefact the image bakes to its sha256. The Dockerfile refuses to build while any value is `REPLACE_ME`, and refuses to build when a downloaded file does not match. Regenerate with: node worker/scripts/update-models.mjs (see README §Model lock), which needs the Hugging Face CDN — the CI runner has it, a developer laptop may not.
